title: Toddler in Bonnet Feeding Ducks, Pond Shore - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century square snapshot capturing a small toddler bundled in a hooded bonnet and jumpsuit, sitting on the sloping bank of a park pond. The child happily scatters pieces of bread or feed to a gathering flock of ducks swimming close to the water's edge, framed by tall reeds and mature trees in the background.
